name: RC-B10-0188/2024 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises Iran for cracking down on women. It condemns laws that force women to cover their heads and punish those who refuse. It names Ahoo Daryaei, who was detained and sent to a psychiatric facility after protesting, and calls this torture. It asks Iran to scrap unfair laws, close the "morality" police, free detained women and let United Nations monitors in. It also asks the European Union to support the "Women, Life, Freedom" movement. These are the Parliament's demands and opinions; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking Iran and the European Union to act.
- **Who it affects:** Women in Iran, including religious minorities, and Iranian authorities.
- **What happens next:** The demands go to the European Commission, the Council and Iranian officials.
